messages:
Maya: Heads-up — I put a first draft of a one-pager + webinar storyboard for the enterprise launch in Drive. Focus: security, SLAs, and deploy mode decisioning. Need quick sync on benchmark narrative, launch posts, webinar CTA, and inbound routing. Can folks review by EOD Wed? :pray: 
Arjun: Looping in PMM. What's the priority persona? CIO/security/compliance or platform/infra? Need that for headline testing.
Maya: Primary: Platform + Security buyers (SRE, Infra, Head of Cloud). Secondary: Product teams evaluating cost/latency tradeoffs. Headline candidates in the doc — 3 variants.
Priya: Saw the doc. Layout looks good. Can we make the hero smaller and add 2-row benchmark callouts? Visuals: latency vs cost chart + deployment iconography for hosted/dedicated/private.
Hannah: Quick data drop — internal benchmark sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/enterprise-launch-bench
Hannah: Snip of numbers: p50=120ms (hosted), 85ms (dedicated), 150ms (private on-prem median). Cost delta table in sheet.
Leo: For marketing copy push the SLA guarantees line: "SLA-backed latency tiers for enterprise workloads" — then bullets to call out failover/routing capabilities.
Sofia: Salesnotes — webinar CTA should gate by company size + industry tags. Route >$250k ARR leads to AE immediately. Smaller demos go to SDR nurture. Need routing spec.
Maya: Draft routing rules in the doc. Example:
````
if lead.annual_commit >= 250000 -> route: AE-team (enterprise)
elif lead.industry in ['finance','healthcare'] -> route: AE-compliance
else -> route: SDR-nurture
````
Arjun: Love that. Run two headline variants in the launch post A/B: Variant A (security-first), Variant B (cost+performance). Test CTR and sign-up conversion.
Priya: Design will prepare two hero variants for A/B. Need final headline text by tomorrow noon.
Hannah: I'll wire up tracking for the two variants and benchmark lead-to-MQL conversions in Looker. Dashboard ETA: 48 hours.
Sofia: Webinar plan: 45min (20m product + 15m benchmarks + 10m customer story + 5m Q&A). Follow-up cadence: Day0 email (recording + playbook), Day3 targeted case study, Day10 AE outreach for routed leads.
Maya: For benchmark narrative — avoid micro-bench claims. Use customer-style framing: "typical real-world throughput and cost improvements using batching, caching, and smart routing" + link to test methodology appendix.
Arjun: Add an ops note on graceful degradation: explain fallback to cheaper model variants when Dedicated hits thresholds. Helps enterprise buyers with resilience concerns.
DevBot: Asset uploaded: /drive/marketing/enterprise/onepager-1749991000-v1.pdf :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks @DevBot and everyone. Action items: Arjun finalize headlines (tomorrow 12pm), Priya design variants (tomorrow EOD), Hannah dashboard (48h), Sofia finalize routing + email sequences (EOD Wed). I'll consolidate and send copy to comms for launch post draft.
Leo: Quick ask — include a short benchmark explainer slide for the webinar that shows methodology bullets? 3 points max.
Hannah: Methodology: 1) production-like workloads; 2) end-to-end latency measurement (p50/p95/p99); 3) cost per 1k tokens with batching on/off.
Sofia: I'll prep invite list segmentation: Platform leads, Security champions, and trial accounts with Dedicated interest flag.
Maya: If no blockers, I'll lock the one-pager by EOD Thu and send to field for preview. Thanks all :rocket: 
Arjun: One more — include a short FAQ on deployment modes + compliance in the one-pager appendix.
Priya: Noted. Will reserve a small accordion in the PDF for that.
Sofia: Added follow-up tasks in our playbook board -> https://trello.com/c/enterprise-launch
Maya: Closing loop — next check-in tomorrow 10:30am PT. Ping me if you need earlier review. :calendar:
